title: Adding to item.cssClasses.item doesn't work

comments.body: Can you show the complete code by editing your question? It lacks some context like what is `facetTemplateCheckbox`?
Also it's not "display: hidden" but "display: none"
Yes, sorry, wrote it incorrect - display:none; Checkbox below. ` var facetTemplateCheckbox = ``` '' + '{{name}}' + '({{count}})' + '';` ```
Here's a jsfiddle doing exactly what you asked: https://jsfiddle.net/n51573u9/

Exactly what I needed! Thank you. The correct answer is `item.cssClasses.item+= ' hide';` needed to be changed to `item.cssClasses.label += ' hide';` Also, it doesnt like when a template is added. `templates: { item: facetTemplateCheckbox }` ` var facetTemplateCheckbox = ``` '' + '{{name}}' + '({{count}})' + '';` ``` Other than that, works fine.

Great! Thanks a lot for the feedback, you can always come to github to ask questions, thats the best, open way.

We uncovered a nasty bug here, updating "item.cssClasses.item" do not work. Thanks.
